text.Larsa: Then please, allow me to accompany you. I've an errand to attend to there.

text.Basch: What manner of errand?

text.Larsa: What errand? I might ask the same of you.

text.Balthier: Right, come on then.

text.Vaan: What?

text.Larsa: Excellent.

text.Balthier: Do me a favor and stay where I can keep my eye on you. Should be less trouble that way.

text.Larsa: For us both.

text.Vaan: So what's your name?

text.Larsa: Oh, I – I'm Lamont.

text.Vaan: Don't worry. I don't know what's in that mine, Lamont, but you're in good hands. Right, Basch?

text.ACTION: Basch and Balthier look at each other in dismay as Vaan nonchalantly reveals Basch's identity. Then Balthier smirks and shrugs. Lamont seems unsuspecting.
Lamont joins the party as a guest!

text.Bhujerban (man in turban and green & bro: Did you know that Bhujerba is the freest city in all Ivalice? His Excellency the Marquis Ondore treats with the Empire to ensure our sovereignty.

text.Bhujerban (woman in white pacing up and: It is most curious. I have lived here all my life, yet I often forget that Bhujerba is, indeed, a city in the sky. If one were to fall from here ... kastam!

text.Bhujerban (moogle with green pom-pom sit: Did you know that House Ondore has maintained Bhujerba's neutrality for ages, kupo? You did? Well did you know that Marquis Ondore's estate is up the steps across the bridge, kupo? You did?

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: You may see Imperials on our streets, bhadra, but do not be alarmed. Bhujerba is neutral. Our ports are open to all.

text.Bhujerban (woman in white sitting on wal: Is it true where you come from, too, that young boys love the sky? My son, he wishes to become a pilot when he is older. Haa ... a pilot!

text.Bhujerban (man in blue, red, and green w: I moved here from Rabanastre, you know. How startled I was to see the Imperials here on such good behavior ... not like those cretins back home.

text.Bhujerban (woman in green, pink, and bro: Bhujerba is not great in size, but as our mines are rich in quality magicite, so are our lives rich. It is a good place to live. Did you know that the best magicite may be used in many applications? It is a most wonderful energy source. There is none greater!

text.Bhujerban (tan bangaa walking up and dow: Seen the Imperials scurrying about? Insects, they are. If I were the Marquis, I'd have given them the boot a long time ago.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Tell me, bhadra, why is it that you have come to Bhujerba? No, do not tell me. For I already know. It is to see her architecture, yes? Many are the travelers who visit us to see her arches and promenades, each built to take advantage of our most lofty position in the sky.

text.Archadian Wayfarer (Travica Way): That Ondore! He has the temerity to turn me, a citizen of the Empire, away at his gate? He needs to be taught a lesson in humility, he does. Eh? Ondore's residence? Just up these steps and to the left. You're not getting in, though. Trust me.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Welcome! I am a parijanah, a sort of guide. May I be of assistance? The way to the Lhusu Mines? Haa, this is difficult. There are many Imperial blockades ... It is a long way, but go southward along this road. You will find it most helpful to purchase a map at the Cartographers'. Of course, you may always ask a parijanah the way, should you become lost. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Cartographers' Guild: How are you enjoying our beautiful city, kupo? Would you like to buy a map, kupo?

text.ACTION: Select a map to purchase.
Bhujerba 70
Lhusu Mines 650
Cancel

text.Bhujerban (woman in white leaning agains: The estate of Marquis Ondore is ahead from here. The Marquis's house is as old as the royal family of Dalmasca, did you know? Perhaps it is now the oldest surviving House in Ivalice.

text.ACTION: If you try to enter Ondore's estate ...

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Beyond this point is the property of his Excellency the Marquis. I am so sorry, but I must ask you to leave, bhadra.

text.ACTION: (Rithil's Protectives (sign)) -Under Charter of His Excellency, we proudly offer such Armors as might prove indispensable to those having Business within the Mines.
If you try to approach any Imperial blockade ...

text.Imperial: Sorry, but this way is closed, on the authority of the Marquis. Why? Wouldn't you like to know.

text.Bhujerban (man in turban and green & bro: Along this road you may find arms, armor, and a seller of magicks, newly open. Many are the miners who come to buy here, for defense is needed against the raksas, or fiends, as you call them, in the mines.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Does the presence of Imperials give you concern? Worry not, Bhujerba is neutral. Should they violate our laws, they will be dealt with, bhadra.

text.Street Kid (Travica Way): Amba, she says the raksas Diabolos will come and take me away to the mines. Who is scared by such fables!? Not me.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Welcome! I am a parijanah, a guide. May I be of assistance? You go to the Lhusu Mines? I am afraid that the hill road to Cloudborne Row is blockaded. I advise going southward down this boulevard. Should you become lost, ask a parijanah. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (woman in white sitting on cra: So many Imperials on the street today! I thought only those on holiday came to our high streets. What could have happened?

text.ACTION: (Targe's Arms (sign)) -Under Charter of His Excellency, we proudly offer such Weapons as might prove indispensable to those having Business within the Mines.

text.Bhujerban (man sitting on crates outside: My wife, she goes quite often into this shop of weapons. For many hours, she does not come out. She loves weapons. She must.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: I was removed from my post by Imperial soldiers! They will stand guard in my place, however. I should be thankful for the rest.

text.City Parijanah: The Lhusu Mines? I warn you, that is not a place for the casual visitor. Go south down this road, and through Miners' End. There are many parijanah guides to assist you. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (tan bangaa pacing boulevard): I've heard there's an Imperial fleet gathering not far from Bhujerba. Now, maybe they're just passin' through ... or maybe this's a prelude to invasion?

text.Bhujerban (woman leaning against wall in: I do not approve of that magickery. The ladies there are all very young, and all very helpful. So do the men flock to their door! Hanta ...

text.Bhujerban (green-pommed moogle sitting o: I came here from Rabanastre to visit a friend, kupo! Them Imperials can't throw their weight around here, can they? That said ... There sure are a lot of them running around today. And what's with all these blockades, kupo!?

text.Shop Clerk (outside Mait's): Svagatam! We are newly open. Come inside Mait's Magicks! We have only the best at Mait's!

text.ACTION: (Mait's Magicks (sign)) -Under Charter of His Excellency, we purvey Magicks restorative and defensive with which to gird oneself before embarking into the Mines.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! I am a parijanah, a sort of guide to our wonderful city. You go to the Lhusu Mines? Then go south down this road, there to pass through Miners' End. Of course, normally one could go straight down this road, but as you can see, it is blockaded. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (man in turban and green & bro: You bear little love for the Empire? Then we have something in common. Thanks to the Empire, my home, Nabradia, is no more. Yes, that's right, I'm Nabradian. For two years I've lived here, waiting ... but for what?

text.Lost Archadian Wayfarer: ... I hate to admit this, but I fear I'm lost. Ridiculous! First I get lost in Rabanastre, now in Bhujerba! It's poor urban planning, I tell you!

text.City Parijanah: Traveler! May I be of assistance? If you are to go to the Lhusu Mines, I suggest you head east from here, passing through Miners' End on your way. There are many shops along the way, should you need anything. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (woman in white leaning agains: Have you been to the Khus Skygrounds? They are to the west of here. The Lhusu Mines? They are to the east. Go through Miners' End.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: The parijanah guides you see around town are working for the state to make sure all visitors to Bhujerba enjoy their time among us.

text.Street Kid: Did you see the soldiers? There were so many!

text.City Parijanah: I am a parijanah. I am here to assist. If you make for the Lhusu Mines, go down this hill and through Miners' End. There are many parijanah guides to help you find your way. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Haa ... The Imperials were here looking for someone a short while ago, but there are so few customers, they left quite quickly, bhadra.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! This is a shop of armors! It is not a bad shop, but the master is a poor salesman. Ayi! Please forget what I have said, yes?

text.Bhujerban (tan seeq browsing on upper le: Mmrph? Look, don't tell anyone I said this, but Rithil's just got me in here to improve his image, see? This place's dead. There's not life in it.

text.Rithil: Svagatam ... welcome ... Armor, not arms, is what we sell. Battle takes more than just a blade ...

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. Welcome to the best armory in Bhujerba. Should you be venturing beyond the city walls, or into the mines, stop here first!

text.Lhusu Miner (man in turban and blue shor: The mines were open from today, but now a party from the Empire's here for an inspection, work has stopped again. Unbelievable! I come here all the way from Nalbina to make some gil, and this happens! I gotta find something else to do ...

text.Lhusu Parivir (blue seeq): Not every ailment is made alike, my friend. In fact, some there are made exactly opposite! Take the magick "slow," for instance. Know someone slow? Slap "haste" on them and away it goes! Why, even the most pernicious afflictions sometimes have the simplest solutions!

text.Lhusu Miner (man in brown shorts examini: Perhaps it is that magicite itself draws raksas to it. Many foul creatures there are in the mines of late. We must protect ourselves, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (woman talking to seated man): Today the mines are closed, so I need not make lunch for my man, you see. It is not a bad thing, to have days like this every now and then.

text.Lhusu Parivir (black bangaa in line at c: The quickest way to victory? Know your enemy's weakness! And how do you find a weakness? Use Libra! And remember, you heard it here first.

text.Lhusu Miner (man standing in line at cou: Quite a crowd here, yes, bhadra? This is the best weaponry Bhujerba has to offer! Always there is a queue.

text.Shop Clerk (Targe's): Welcome! Welcome! Targe's Arms is here to serve your every need ... as long as your every need is weapons!

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.Lhusu Miner (man in turban and blue shor: Guns ... yes, guns have good range, and bullets pierce armor as though 'twere paper, but against some raksas, they are useless. Flans, for instance.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Raksas roam the Lhusu Mines, hunting the unwary. To protect themselves against these creatures of all description, the miners must be armed, you see. The mining of magicite is of great importance to Bhujerba. It behooves us all to see that the miners are working safely.

text.Bhujerban (woman browsing weapons on upp: Haa ... I wonder if there is a weapon that I, too, might use? Kah? Why do I need a weapon? Have you seen my husband?

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. Welcome to this fine shop of quality magicks, newly opened. Here shall you find all you need to prepare for your journeys.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: I am a rakis guard of the watch, stationed here. Of late, I, too, desire to study magicks. I promise, it is not out of desire for the staff here, no!

text.Shop Clerk (woman in pink, red, and blue: Welcome to Mait's. We are new to this, but every day we learn more and more of our trade. I beg your continued patronage, bhadra. (wink)

text.Bhujerban (man bent over inspecting shel: Hanta ... So many difficult books here. Can one such as me truly learn magick? I think no.

text.Shop Clerk (woman in pink and blue with: Good day. Feel free to browse our selection of magicks. We've many magicks sure to be helpful to a traveler such as yourself, bhadra!

text.Mait: Welcome to Mait's Magicks, newly opened! Remember: we are here to serve you!

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.Shop Clerk (woman in blue, pink and gree: The magicite taken from Lhusu Mines is known for its quality. Indeed, many of our magicks here are worked with local stones ... Yet of late, it seems that the quality is not what it used to be.

text.Bhujerban (man in blue on upper level): Until a short while ago, this shop was, in fact, a tavern, you see. Hungry, I came here to find that now it sells magicks, not food. Haa ... but they used to serve the most delicious stews, bhadra ...

text.Bhujerban Guru (Mait's): Marquis Ondore keeps a wary distance from the Empire, bhadra. Our relations with Archades are cordial, for now, though I fear for the future ...

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Kah? The dayworkers? No, today there is no mining in Lhusu. Have you not heard? An inspection party from the Empire has come.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Welcome to Bhujerba. I am a parijanah, a guide to our fair city. If you would go to the Lhusu Mines, head down this slope, and north along Miners' End. Know the mines are closed now. There is no entry.

text.Miners' Ender (man in green and brown sh: Have I seen you in Miners' End before? I thought not. Welcome, bhadra. Perhaps you are here to enjoy the flavor of old Bhujerba?

text.Bhujerban Guru (Miner's End): Ah ... I seen some sour-lookin' bangaa about. Eh? Bangaa ... and a hume girl? Sorry, bhadra. Seen nothin' of the sort.

text.Shop Clerk (Miner's End): Welcome to Clio's Technicks, kupo! Open for business, and ready to serve!

text.ACTION: (Clio's Technicks (sign)) -His Excellency having deemed Technicks nonessential to Mining Operations, we operate without Charter. Rest assured that all Technicks bear our personal guarantee!

text.Miners' Ender (moogle with orange pom-po: Oh, on a typical day, I find myself down in the mines, fixing the carts, the tracks, the diggers ... But today is a holiday, kupo!

text.Miners' Ender (man in white turban and d: Have you wondered at the lack of fallows and fields in Bhujerba, bhadra? Yes, we have little space for such things. That is why we must sell our Stones and import what foodstuffs we need.

text.Miners' Ender (woman in pink top and hea: I've just finished work in Rabanastre ... What a terrible place it is. The Empire is everywhere. I felt quite suffocated, yes.

text.Miners' Ender (guy sitting on ledge next: The soldiers, it seems they are looking for someone. I hope they find whoever it is, and leave us soon. Can they not see we are in love?

text.Miners' Ender (woman in pink, blue, and: You may see many Imperials about, bhadra, but it is not always so. Bhujerbans are a proud, independent people. Not cows like the Dalmascans.

text.Lhusu Miner (Bhorta): Hanta! One of the Imperials, in his haste he has stepped upon my foot! Ayi ... Next I see him, he shall pay. Bhorta swears it!

text.Miners' Ender (green-pommed moogle sitti: The Imperials seem quite agitated today, kupo! How am I to take my nap with all this toing and froing?

text.Miners' Ender Kid: How I wanted to play on the Kaff Terrace, but the Imperials, they block our way! It is not fair! Back to Archades with you, murkha Imperials!

text.City Parijanah: Lost your way? Allow a parijanah to assist you! Ah, you go to the Lhusu Mines, perhaps? This road, it leads to Kaff Terrace. If you go straight up this slope, you will reach a junction. There, go to the east and you will find the road to the mines.

text.Lhusu Miner (black bangaa yelling at moo: Moogle! Your days are numbered, do you hear me!? Come down here at once! Adhuna! Now!

text.Miners' Ender (woman in pink, blue and y: No, of course I do not like the Imperials on our streets, but it is better than resisting them and ending up like Dalmasca, no? Independence is not won for free, you see.

text.Lhusu Parivir: Nnh? This here's Miners' End, bhadra. Lhusu, that's north ... But it's closed, say the criers. How's a seeq to earn an honest day's wage?

text.Miners' Ender (moogle in gold with orang: Oh, so many hills in this town, kupo! I suppose that's what the travelers come here to see. But me, I cannot see for the sweat in my eyes, kupo!

text.Lhusu Miner (man in dark shorts sitting: Good day, bhadra. Have you been to the mines? I am a miner, you see. We who dig the Stones must be ready for raksas attacks, to fight them as one. That is why we frequent Bashketi's Gambits!

text.ACTION: (Bashketi's Gambits (sign)) -Gambits having been deemed nonessential to Mining Operations, we operate without Charter, though we believe Efficiency is quintessential!

text.Miners' Ender (woman in pink leaning aga: Ah, you seem new to this place, yes? You do know where you are? We are on Dorstonis, one of the purvama, the floating lands. Many are the visitors from all parts of Ivalice who come to see the wonder that is Bhujerba. That is why the city employs guides, the parijanah.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Haa? The Lhusu Mines? They are closed, bhadra. You are a traveler, yes? I do not think they will let you in, with the Imperial inspections.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. How may I assist you? Should you go east from this junction, you will reach the mines. West, Cloudborne Row.

text.Lhusu Miner (man in green and brown shor: Today the mines are closed and so I think to go to the Cloudborne for a drink, yes? What is the harm in a drink?

text.Shop Clerk (moogle in blue with yellow p: Ours is a moogle-run shop, but we serve everyone! Buy, and know happiness, kupo!

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. Welcome to Clio's Technicks. This shop is run by the Bhujerban Alliance of Moogles, B.A.M.! Quality is guaranteed!

text.Shop Clerk (moogle with yellow pom-pom a: Very sorry, kupo! Staff only beyond here ...

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: A most industrious race, moogles. Bhujerba owes much to their mooglecraft. Cute, too, do you not think?

text.Archadian Wayfarer (Clio's): My brother works in a laboratory in Archades. He says he will come soon to Bhujerba on military duty, and, if time allows, learn mooglecraft.

text.Shop Clerk (moogle with green pom-pom at: Staff only, up here, kupo! ... Where is that Pilika!? She was supposed to be here hours ago, and today is my holiday, kupo!

text.Shop Clerk (moogle in red with green pom: Oh, if there's anything you need, anything at all, don't hesitate to ask, kupo! There's no need to be shy! We're all born ignorant, as they say, kupo!

text.Clio: Clio's Technicks ... How may I help you, kupo?

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam! Welcome to Bashketi's Gambits. I hardly need remind you of gambits' usefulness. The key to life, bhadra, is teamwork!

text.Shop Clerk (light blue seeq): Svagatam! Welcome! Buy our gambits and weather the stormiest journey with ease.

text.Bhujerban (woman in pink and blue top wi: Haa ... There are so many gambits! I wonder if there is one to help me run my household?

text.Bhujerban (man in turban and green & bro: I have heard there is a resistance in our city, preparing to rise against the Empire ... but how can they operate with Imperials on every corner?

text.Bhujerban (man at counter): There is a limit to gambits' effectiveness, bhadra. Gambits meant to aid one's companions will do them no good should they wander too far afield. This is when you should tell them what to do directly, you see. It is vital for you to use both gambits, and old-fashioned orders, well!

text.Bashketi: Look upon my wares and know perfection, bhadra! Yes, it is I, Bashketi. And these are my gambits!

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.Shop Clerk (orange seeq on upper level): Questions about gambits? (snort) Ask away! There's much I'd like to ask of you, too! (snort)

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Did you know the miners in Lhusu use gambits? There are many raksas in the mines, you see. The miners must defend themselves, bhadra!

text.Miners' Ender (woman leaning against wal: I hear that the quality of the magicite taken from the mines has dropped, but this is most odd. All the Stones I have seen are of highest grade!

text.Lhusu Parivir (Lhusu Square): We are parivir, sworn to defend those who work the mines. Many raksas dwell in Lhusu! Very, very dangerous place. Thus are we needed. You have the look of someone new. You would do well to hire us, should you wish to enter Lhusu. Of course, not today, for the mines are closed.

text.Lhusu Miner (man with back against wall): You carry potions and elixirs, do you not? Haa ... Their value cannot be overestimated! Better than magicks, many times. Especially for healing!

text.Lhusu Miner (man sitting cross-legged on: A friend of mine, he found a great treasure deep in the mines, but when he went to reach for it, ayi! It was a raksas! A most horrible fiend! Not all treasure is treasure, bhadra.

text.Street Vendor: Normally I sell my wares to the miners, bhadra, but with the mines closed, business is, how shall I say it? Dead. Take a look, won't you?

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.Cartographers' Guild: On a trip into the mines? Would you like to buy a map, kupo?

text.ACTION: Select a map to purchase.
Bhujerba 70
Lhusu Mines 650
Cancel

text.Aekom: Today all work in the mines had stopped, bhadra. An inspection party has come from Archadia, yes. They have brought many guards. There is no need for our guild of bodyguards, the parivir.

text.ACTION: Vaan stands before the mines. Balthier, Basch, Fran and Lamont follow not far behind him.

text.Balthier: The Lhusu Mines: one of the richest veins in Ivalice.

text.Basch: Under Imperial guard, no doubt.

text.Larsa: Actually, no. With but few exceptions, the Imperial army is not permitted in Bhujerba. Well, shall we proceed?

text.ACTION: Balthier and Basch exchange a look. Lamont heads for the mine entrance.

Another party is heading in from the entrance. Vaan, Basch, Balthier, Fran, and Lamont all retreat into the shadows. One is identified as an Imperial Judge by his extravagant armor. The other you recognize once you hear the voice.

text.Judge Ghis: You will forgive me for asking, but you are diverting the purest of the magicite –

text.Ondore: I can assure you it reaches Lord Vayne most discreetly.

text.Judge Ghis: You wear your saddle well.

text.Ondore: Be that as it may, I have no intention of being bridled, Your Honor.

text.Judge Ghis: Then you prefer the whip? Stubbornness will see not only you broken, Excellency, but Bhujerba as well.

text.Larsa: Halim Ondore IV, the Marquis of Bhujerba. The Marquis served as the mediator at the negotiations of Dalmasca's surrender. It would appear that he is somewhat less neutral now.

text.Balthier: They say he's been helping the Resistance.

text.Larsa: They say many things.

text.Balthier: You're certainly well informed. Who did you say you were again?

text.Vaan: What difference does it make? We have to find Penelo.

text.Larsa: And Penelo is your –

text.Vaan: She's a friend. She was kidnapped and taken here.

text.ACTION: The party walks into a massive cavern with glowing blue walls.

text.Larsa: This is what I came here to see.

text.ACTION: Lamont draws an oblong, glowing stone from his pockets.

text.Vaan: What's that?

text.Larsa: It's nethicite. Manufacted nethicite.

text.Vaan: Nethicite?

text.Larsa: Unlike regular magicite, nethicite absorbs magickal energy. This is the fruit of research into the manufacture of nethicite. All at the hands of the Draklor Laboratory.

text.ACTION: Balthier side eyes Lamont at the mention of Draklor. Lamont wanders off to another cavern wall.

text.Larsa: So this is where they're getting the magicite.

text.Balthier: Errand all attended to, then?

text.Larsa: Thank you. I'll repay you shortly.

text.ACTION: Balthier saunters toward him, slowly cornering him, pressing him up to the wall.

text.Balthier: No, you'll repay us now. We have too much on our hands to go on holding yours. So where did you hear this fairy tale about "nethicite"? And where did you get that sample you carry? What do you know about the Draklor Laboratories? Tell me: who are you?

text.Vaan: Balthier –

text.ACTION: They turn to see Ba'Gamnan, with a lethal looking weapon with a sort of rotating sawblade at the end of a long pole, henchman at his side.

text.Ba'Gamnan: You slipped away in Nalbina. We missed you! First the Judge, and now this boy. The whole affair has the smell of money. I may have to wet my beak a little.

text.Balthier: Keep your snout in the trough where it belongs. This thinking ill befits you, Ba'Gamnan.

text.Ba'Gamnan: Balthier! Too long have I gone unpaid! I'll carve my bounty out of that boy!

text.Vaan: Where's Penelo? We're taking her back!

text.Ba'Gamnan: The girl? Why keep the bait when you've landed the fish? We cut her loose on the way here and then off she ran, crying like a babe!

text.ACTION: Lamont throws the magicite; it bonks Ba'Gamnan on the head and he grunts in pain. The gang takes the opportunity to run for it, Balthier shoving him to the ground as he passes and Fran jumping over his prostrate body.
getting up and grabbing his weapon again
The party sprints back down the tunnels, first Lamont, then Vaan, then Balthier, Basch, and Fran.
yelling to Lamont

text.Vaan: Hey, wait up!

text.Balthier: We'll not be able to take them all! Fight who we must, leave the rest.

text.Fran: It would not seem they follow. We've lost them.

text.Balthier: Much more running about with bangaa at my heels ... and I'm apt to give up sky pirating altogether.

text.ACTION: As the party emerges from the mines, they see the judge and the marquis waiting outside with a soldier. They all go to hide, except Lamont, who approaches them.

text.Judge Ghis: I see you've been out walking without the company of your cortege ... Lord Larsa.

text.ACTION: The Imperial steps aside to reveal Penelo is with the Imperial party.

text.Judge Ghis: We caught her wandering out of the mines. You must take care with such undesirables about.

text.Penelo: I was kidnapped –

text.Judge Ghis: Silence!

text.Larsa: If it is a crime to wander on one's own ... then I, too, am guilty. Marquis. I trust that your estate can accommodate another guest?

text.Ondore: Why not?

text.Larsa: Judge Ghis, I shall heed your counsel. I will not travel unaccompanied any longer.

text.ACTION: He pointedly takes Penelo by the hand and walks away.

text.Judge Ghis: That was unexpected.

text.Larsa: Thank you, Penelo.

text.Penelo: O-Of course.

text.ACTION: As they walk away, the rest of the gang comes out from behind the pillars.

text.Vaan: What's Penelo doing? And what's the deal with that Lamont?

text.Balthier: That's no "Lamont." Larsa Ferrinas Solidor. Fourth son to Emperor Gramis ... and brother to Vayne.

text.Vaan: What? That kid!?

text.Fran: Do not worry. I believe he will treat her well.

text.Balthier: Nobody knows men like Fran does.

text.Basch: Our purposes lead the same way: to Ondore. We must find means to approach him.

text.Balthier: The Marquis is channeling money to organizations opposing the Empire. We'll start there.

text.Aekom: The one with the shiny armor, he was a Judge of Archadia, yes? Haa ... More impressive than ever I imagined, he was! The Marquis must do as they say.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the area at the top of the stairs ...

text.Basch: Marquis Ondore announced my execution 2 years ago. If news of my survival were to spread, the Marquis may find his position compromised.

text.Balthier: The men he's been funding bear little love for the Empire. They won't be thrilled to discover that rumors of your death were, in fact, greatly exaggerated. If we were to raise a clamor to that effect, we might just get their attention.

text.Vaan: Nothin' to it! I'll just go around town spreading the word. How 'bout this?

text.ACTION: You are prompted to press the square button ...
yelling

text.Vaan: I'm Captain Basch fon Ronsenburg of Dalmasca!

text.ACTION: The denizens of Lhusu Square turn heads at Vaan.

text.Vaan: Well? What do you think?

text.Balthier: That certainly qualifies as a clamor. All right, Vaan, get to it. For the girl's sake, eh? Oh, and the more people around to witness your little performance, the better. If we're going to reach the Marquis, it's up to you. We'll be waiting here, if you need us.

His Excellency Marquis Ondore announced after the war that Captain Basch fon Ronsenburg had been executed ... for slaying his own king. Now, as we all know, Basch lives. Should this become known, why, the Marquis's lie would be revealed, and his Resistance jeopardized.

text.Basch: Spread the rumor that I still live, and the Resistance here in Bhujerba will come out of their hiding places to ascertain the truth. If we can contact their organization, we can use them to get to the Marquis. We'll rescue Penelo from his estate, and see where he stands.

text.Fran: Walk the streets of Bhujerba and speak of Basch where people have gathered. We will await you here.

text.Street Vendor: The Imperials are gone, and business is booming! Do take a look, bhadra!

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. How may I assist you? Ah, yes, the great edifice of our city, visible from all wards and piers. Marquis Ondore's estate! To go to the estate, go to the west from here to Cloudborne Row, and north from there.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Haa? The mines? They are closed, bhadra. They will resume mining tomorrow, however. Not that mining is very enjoyable to view.

text.Lhusu Miner (man in green and brown shor: The Imperials are gone, yes? And so, with thirst in my throat, I go to the Cloudborne, only to find my purse is quite empty! Kastam ...

text.Miners' Ender (moogle in gold with orang: So, so many hills in this town of ours! (pant) I must keep healthy, kupo, or I can't get about. What to do when I am an old moogle?

text.Lhusu Miner (black bangaa yelling at moo: Moogle! You think you are so clever! You think you are so innocent with your ... your pom-pom! I know the truth! I know what you have done!

text.Miners' Ender Kid: Kah? Oh, ahead is Kaff Terrace, yes. You are not from Bhujerba, are you? Then be prepared! It is quite thrilling there, you see.

text.City Parijanah: Lost your way? Allow a parijanah to assist you! Kah? You go to the estate of his Excellency the Marquis? Then first, go to Cloudborne Row. Walk up this slop to the junction at top. There, go east and you will reach the Row. From there, go north, bhadra. When you see the shining wings dancing into blue sky, you will know the way you must go.

text.Miners' Ender (green-pommed moogle sitti: Do you know why there are so many hills in Bhujerba? Because the purvama it was built upon, Dorstonis, is hilly! Kupo!

text.Lhusu Miner (Bhorta): I have seen the Marquis running along like a dog to these Judges. Bhorta cares for this not. How can we leave Bhujerba in the hands of such a man?

text.Miners' Ender (woman in pink, blue, and: Hanta! Never before have the Imperials had the temerity to blockade our roads! The Marquis falters, I fear. This is a shame on us!

text.Miners' Ender (guy sitting on ledge next: I heard a soldier, an Imperial, above us. He said that the great fleet of the Empire approaches Bhujerba! Can this be true?

text.Miners' Ender (woman in pink top and hea: You are from Rabanastre? I have heard from a friend there. "We lost all," she said, "because Captain Ronsenburg took away our king."

text.Miners' Ender (woman in pink, blue and y: Who knows what the Marquis thinks? He was close to the royal family of Dalmasca, yet in the war two years past, he aided Archades! Curious ...

text.Lhusu Parivir: Aye, magicite mining's starting up again on the morrow, down at Site 3 ... Got to go down to the Staras place 'n' get my key ... Mmmmrph.

text.Miners' Ender (moogle with orange pom-po: Me? Normally, I am working in the mines, fixing the machines. Today, I rest, kupo, but tomorrow, tomorrow work begins again!

text.Bhujerban Guru (Miner's End): Ah ... I seen some sour-lookin' bangaa about. Wastrels like them shouldn't be let to roam the streets. 'Tis bad for our image, eh?

text.Miners' Ender (man in green and brown sh: Here in Miners' End is where the workers of our city live. It is an odd name, I agree. Today the Mines are closed, and so the streets are busy.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Welcome to Bhujerba. I am a parijanah, a guide to our fair city. You would go to the Marquis's estate? Very well. Go up this slope to Travica Way, and from there, go north until you reach it, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Kah? A Resistance against the Empire? Cloudspit! Bhujerba's relations with Archades are nothing if not cordial. No Resistance exists. It cannot.

text.City Parijanah: Yes, traveler, this is Bashketi's Gambits. The R-Resistance hall? I have not heard of such a thing. I am sorry, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (woman in pink and blue top wi: Haa ... There are so many gambits! I wonder if there is one to make my husband was the dishes?

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: The staff here are all run by gambits, bhadra. Are you not impressed by their efficiency? It is a testament to the quality of their product!
Up ahead is Kaff Terrace, famed spot of Bhujerba. The Khus Skygrounds near Travica Way, too, are magnificent, but the Terrace is thrilling, bhadra!

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Here on Kaff Terrace, witness the most beautiful scenery Bhujerba has to offer! Its beauty needs no description ... so do I rest.

text.Bhujerban (black bangaa): The Imperials have closed off the road! This is an outrage! All this concern over a child? Even if he is the son of the Emperor! Kastam!

text.Bhujerban (green-pommed moogle walking a: Did you know, kupo, that Bhujerba floats by the power of magicite? That's what the natural philosophers think, at least ... Wait, does that mean if the mines run out of magicite we'll fall out of the sky and become a normal island ... in the sea?

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: It appears the Imperial blockades have been lifted. I still do not understand why the Marquis has given them the run of our streets!

text.Bhujerban (man in red, green, and blue t: Ivalice is truly a place of much wonder. But Bhujerba is the only city-state built atop a purvama! Kah? A purvama is a sky island, you see.

text.Bhujerban (man in brown pants and green: The airships of other lands, they pass this way as they make for the aerodrome. My love, she too will be borne home on the skies.

text.Bhujerban (moogle with green pom-pom wal: I'm fine, fine, kupo! Why, if anything should happen, I've always got my wings!

text.Bhujerban (woman in pink, green, and tan: Sometimes, the cargo ships come to this terrace. I am always so impressed the men can do their work here, where there is no railing ...

text.Bhujerban (man in green and brown shorts: The great edifice you see ahead is none other than the residence of Marquis Ondore ... though you can hardly see it for the trees, haa?

text.Bhujerban (light blue seeq at left of st: Mmrrph. Imperials were running about, looking for someone, they was. But when they come out here, how their knees did knock! Bwa ha ha!

text.Bhujerban (moogle with yellow pom-pom si: When I'm feeling sad, I come here and gaze out at the sky. Here, my problems feel very small, kupo. Like me!

text.Bhujerban (woman in red, pink, and blue,: I've dropped a ring, near to here, bhadra. Ayi, it was a ring of great importance! Kastam!

text.Yrlon: I have quarreled with Amba, so I shall not go home a while, I am thinking. I do not care if she is worried! If you should meet her, please, bhadra, do not tell her I am here. Please.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. Welcome to Clio's Technicks. This shop is run by the Bhujerban Alliance of Moogles, B.A.M.! Quality is guaranteed, kupo! ... Ahem. Forgive me, I seem to have picked up the moogle's dialect, kupo. Ahem.

text.Shop Clerk (moogle in blue with yellow p: Ours is a moogle-run shop, but we serve everyone! Buy, and know happiness, kupo! ... A Resistance against the Empire? No, the Empire's always treated us fairly, kupo. I'm sure that's just a silly rumor!

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: There are many moogles in Bhujerba, for they are privileged here. Only natural for a people that has contributed so much to Bhujerba's growth.

text.Archadian Wayfarer (Clio's): My brother works in a laboratory in Archades. He will soon arrive in Bhujerba with the 8th Fleet. I am to wait for him here, you see.

text.Shop Clerk (moogle with green pom-pom at: Staff only, up here, kupo! ... Where is that Pilika!? We moogles may look cute and cuddly, but when it's time to work, we work! Except for ... when we don't.

text.City Parijanah: I am a parijanah. I am here to assist. If you are to call on the Marquis at his estate, head north along the boulevard. There are many parijanah guides to help you find your way. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Street Kid (Travica Way): Tatah works in the mines, but today he has off. He will play with me today!

text.Bhujerban (woman in white leaning agains: Down to the west lie the Khus Skygrounds. Very scenic, very recommended, bhadra. Through Miners' End to the east are the mines.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: The parijanah guides you see around town are working for the state to make sure all visitors to Bhujerba enjoy their time among us.

text.City Parijanah: Traveler! May I be of assistance? If you seek the Marquis Ondore's estate, I recommend you go north, straight along this boulevard. Down this slope lie the Khus Skygrounds, a most scenic location, its beauty befitting a skycity. Good journey to you, bhadra.
Svagatam, traveler! Have you seen the Marquis's Estate? It is at the northern end of the boulevard. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (green-pommed moogle sitting o: I came here from Rabanastre to visit a friend, kupo! I've taken to the place more than I thought ... In fact, I might just stay here, kupo.

text.Bhujerban (man in green and brown shorts: Hmm? I was a soldier of Nabradia. A defender. But what could I defend? Nothing. Two years ago I came here to Bhujerba. Two long years ...

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Where have all the Imperials gone? Never mind, it is a good thing. I have pity for Rabanastre, always the unwilling host to their ilk.

text.Bhujerban (man sitting on crates outside: Marquis Ondore and an Imperial Judge just passed this way with many soldiers in their retinue! I thought to tell my wife of this, but she does not come out. I fear she must truly, truly love weapons. It is the only explanation.

text.Bhujerban (woman in white sitting on cra: I have heard for what the Imperials search high and low. It is the youngest son of the Emperor! Perhaps he merely spreads his wings? Haa, youth ...

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Welcome! I am a parijanah, a guide. May I be of assistance? You go to Marquis Ondore's estate? Then go north, all the way up this road. By the way, down from here is Cloudborne Row. May I recommend a fine Bhujerban Madhu at the Cloudborne? Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: It appears that the Imperial fleet has left us. Worry not. Bhujerba is not Rabanastre. Here, the Imperials have little power, you see.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Welcome! I am a parijanah, a guide. May I be of assistance? You wish to go to Marquis Ondore's estate? Then go north, all the way up. I am afraid the estate is off limits to visitors, yet even from outside it is quite beautiful, you see. Good journey to you, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (woman in white leaning agains: The estate of Marquis Ondore is ahead from here. He is a very powerful man – even the Empire respects this. An audience may be difficult to arrange.

text.Bhujerban (tan bangaa walking up and dow: It's about time those Imperials made themselves scarce. I'm sure the Marquis has plans of his own ... But were I him, I'd cut ties with the Empire. Now.

text.Bhujerban (woman in green, pink, and bro: Our Bhujerba is a small land, but House Ondore has long protected the mines. They, and the airship traders are a source of much wealth, you see.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Kah? The Marquis supports a resistance? Against the Empire!? This is ludicrous. Slander the Marquis no further, or I shall have you arrested.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. Up the steps here you will find Travica Way, our main boulevard. At its north end stands the magnificent Ondore estate.

text.Bhujerban (black bangaa walking about): Kah? A Resistance against the Empire? This is Bhujerba! Unlike some kingdoms, we know how to deal with Archades here. Cloudspit! Pah!

text.Pilika: Oh dear, kupo ... I have ... (sigh) I cannot tell you. You are a stranger.

text.Street Kid (in blue, on ledge): We're going to play at sky pirates! No, you may not join us. Do not bother asking!

text.Bhujerban (woman in pink, blue, and red: Once there were many vendors here, but their numbers have fallen since the Empire came. Only this one stallholder remains, you see.

text.ACTION: (Kweli's Last Stand (sign)) -Without Charter of His Excellency, Member Khus Skygrounds Merchants' Guild. We'll match any price, anywhere!

text.Street Vendor (Kweli's Last Stand): Traveler! Pause a moment! Take a look!

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: The Marquis, supporting a Resistance against the Empire? This is a lie spread by those who tire of the peace the Marquis has brought us, bhadra.

text.Bhujerban (woman in pink headscarf leani: This man next to me, he stares and he stares. I wish he would stop. I wait here for my boyfriend! If he were to see this ...

text.Bhujerban (man in blue leaning on ledge): When I was a child, long I stood here watching the airships fly to and fro. All day could I watch. I wanted ... I wanted to be a sky pirate! Ha ha!

text.Bhujerban (light blue seeq walking aroun: Mrrnh? Aye, I dislike the Empire. Who wouldn't? But you hold it inside, and you treat with them. This is what it means to be an adult, yes?

text.Street Kid (in yellow, with mother kneel: An Imperial soldier gave me a sweet, so I took it. Why is amba cross with me?

text.Bhujerban (moogle with green pom-pom): Clio's Technicks in Miners' End! We're your first and last stop for technicks, kupo! Master Clio is a personal friend! We moogles stick together!

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. Welcome to the Khus Skygrounds, favored leisure spot of all Bhujerbans. Quite beautiful, do you not agree?
Svagatam, traveler. Welcome to this fine shop of quality magicks, newly opened. A resistance? Sorry, this was not written of in my guidebook!

text.Shop Clerk (woman in pink, red, and blue: Welcome, traveler, to Mait's. Kah? A resistance? Against Archadia? I am sorry, bhadra, but we have no dealings with such people.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: I am a rakis guard of the watch, stationed here. Of late, I, too, desire to study magicks, for defense in these times of much disorder. Kah ... ? A resistance? No, such a thing does not exist. I am afraid you have been tricked, bhadra.

text.Shop Clerk (woman in blue, pink and gree: The magicite taken from Lhusu is known for its quality. Indeed, many of our magicks here are worked with local stones ... Yet of late, we cannot seem to get enough!

text.Bhujerban Guru (Mait's): Marquis Ondore keeps a wary distance from the Empire, bhadra. Our relations with Archades are cordial, for now, though I fear for the future ... Never before have Judge Magisters walked so boldly on Bhujerban soil, you see.

text.Lhusu Miner (man in turban and blue shor: I've just come here from Nalbina to make some gil. The mines were closed today, but from tomorrow, I'll be down there diggin' to my heart's content!

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: I have been a rakis – a guard – here for quite some time now, and I can say with some confidence that nothing ever happens here, bhadra. Why, you ask? I would think it obvious.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! This is a shop of armors! Kah ... ? A resistance against the Empire? Do not say such things, bhadra! Shocking!

text.Shop Clerk (Rithil's): Svagatam ... (yawn) Kah ... ? A resistance against the Empire? Never heard of it ...

text.Rithil: Svagatam ... welcome ... Protectives ... protectives ... Why does Targe get all the business? What does he have that I do not?

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.Bhujerban (tan seeq browsing on upper le: Mrmmph? A resistance? No one half as interesting as that'd come to this shop, believe you me. Can't you tell?

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Welcome to Cloudborne Row. Turn the corner, and you will find the Cloudborne, purveyor of fine Bhujerban Madhu!

text.Cloudborne Resident (man in turban and g: This street is not a place for travelers, bhadra. It does not do to wander the back alleys. You might become lost. You might find trouble.

text.Cloudborne Resident (tan bangaa in green: How is it that Judges walk our streets as though they belonged here, their soldiers with them? The Marquis is a fair-weather friend to his people!

text.Cloudborne Resident (tan seeq with turqu: I saw the Marquis Ondore and a Judge pass by not moments ago. The Marquis ... any lesser man would quail before a Judge, but he stood proud.

text.Cloudborne Kid: My sister works at the Cloudborne, though she is no bar-wench, but the taverner. Very busy, very strict. Best not to trouble her, no.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Back here, bhadra, it is not lost travelers, but lost drinkers whom we must care for. Take the spirits, but care the spirits do not take you.

text.Cloudborne Resident (woman in white lean: I have just heard that Captain Ronsenburg of Dalmasca was spotted in Lhusu Square! Drivel from the mouths of drunkards!

text.Drunken Archadian Wayfarer: P-Pardon ... Please, stop shouting like that ... Urgh, my head, it pounds! Bhujerban Madhu is as sweet as her maids, and as strong as her Stones!

text.Cloudborne Resident (moogle in gold with: My first ever visit to the Cloudborne. It's been a long time coming. I'm going in, kupo! With a friend. Once we can find the door.

text.Cloudborne Patron (light blue seeq): Yer not from around here, are you? Well, this here's the Cloudborne, favored watering-hole of miner and traveler alike. Those guides you see around, the parijanah, they hold meetings here, too.

text.Cloudborne Patron (man standing beside c: Every time we drink, this! I tell him, count the cups, count the cups, and does he count them? Yes! If only he would stop counting ...

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! If it is shopping you desire, do see Travica Way. Why, Targe's Arms is just up the stairs here, you see. Here ... this is more of an alley, to tell the truth. Most come here only for drinking ... that would be at the tavern down the slope. Good journey!

text.Bhujerban Guru (Cloudborne Row): Haa ... I have recently met the leader of the parijanah guides, Havharo. Very mysterious, very handsome! He frequents the Cloudborne, you know.

text.Cloudborne Resident (tan bangaa in green: The other day, a man in his cups was shouting of the Marquis's "involvement" with some anti-Imperial resistance. Now ... he is gone. The lesson: show the fool's coin, pay the fool's price.

text.Lhusu Miner (man in green and brown shor: They say the Lhusu Mines are silent today. People talk of important men from the Empire come to see the mines. The ones in armor, perhaps?

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: I have heard that the quality of our Stones is dropping, but this is because the Empire buys all the best. I trust the Empire not, with their laboratories and their experiments. What are they up to?

text.Archadian Wayfarer (Cloudborne Row): I came to see the source of the power that keeps this land of Dorstonis afloat, yet with the Lhusu Mines closed ...

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler! Welcome to Bhujerba! Wish you to see the estate of his Excellency the Marquis? Then go you down Travica Way. You can see the estate at the north end of the Way from most parts of Bhujerba. It is quite impressive, and a useful landmark, if you are lost.
Svagatam, traveler! You have been to Travica Way? It is right up these steps. And Mait's Magicks is at its end. I recommend stopping there, oh yes.

text.Cloudborne Resident (woman talking with: Have the inspectors from the Empire left? I mistrust the Empire. After what I saw in Nalbina, who wouldn't?

text.Cloudborne Resident (moogle in gold with: This building here? Why, this is the Staras residence, kupo. House Staras has long controlled the Lhusu Mines. They're nobility!

text.Cloudborne Resident (man sitting on crat: I hear an Imperial fleet is to put in to port quite soon. Each fleet arrival is a great opportunity for our merchants to sell, you see.

text.Cloudborne Resident (light blue seeq wal: Careful on these streets. Gets dangerous 'round here at night. Bunch o' drunks gave me a right beatin' just the other night. Think they were part of this resistance group I been hearing about.

text.City Parijanah (talking to woman at tabl: Pardon. As you can see, I am occupied. If you have a question, you may ask another parijanah, please. This said, all the parijanah here are off duty, I should hope.

text.Shop Clerk (woman in green, pink, and br: Hanta ... I am so busy! It is because of that lazy Magu! He is that seeq in his cups and out of his wits by the barrel there. He is paid for this!?

text.Shop Clerk (moogle with green pom-pom): Care for some Bhujerban Madhu? It's a local favorite, kupo! Oh, wait, you're far too young, kupo. Come back later! Much later!

text.Cloudborne Patron (man in white shorts s: If you seek posted bills for hunting marks, you can find them on the board at the far end of the tavern, bhadra. Would you make a name for yourself? Then you'd do well to check there early, so another does not hunt all the marks before you!

text.Cloudborne Patron (woman sitting at tabl: The Marquis supporting a resistance against the Empire? It is best not to speak of such nonsense in a place like this, bhadra. You never know who might be listening.

text.Cloudborne Patron (man sitting at table: When the Imperials were here, it was hard to relax and enjoy a cup. Now, I can drink to my heart's content. As it so happens, my heart's quite thirsty.

text.Cloudborne Patron (blue seeq at bar): Have you tasted the spirit known as Bhujerban Madhu? It is a local favorite! Only reluctantly do we allow outsiders to drink it. Especially not boys! Come back when you are a man grown, and we shall see then.

text.Magu: Harrum? Melisa call for me? Kah!? A resist-er-rance? Mmrrrph. (snort) What's that? Is it good eatin'?

text.Cloudborne Patron (moogle with yellow po: Oh, I'm here to meet a friend, kupo! But ... he's nowhere to be seen. I'm thirsty!

text.Melisa: Welcome to the Cloudborne, traveler, where all Bhujerba comes to forget the worries of the day. I'm the taverner, Melisa, at your service. Sit down, rest your feet, boy ... Kah? A resistance? Crazy! All right, who gave this boy here a sip of the madhu?

text.City Parijanah (with blue jacket): A resistance against the Empire, bhadra? Surely, there are many in our city who dislike the Empire, yet the Marquis has ever remained neutral. Were such a group to form, why, they would all be arrested with due haste, I think.

text.Cloudborne Patron (man leaning on bar, s: There are many who believe that Bhujerba might defy the Empire with economic superiority, bhadra, but I disagree. Were the Imperials to block off our trade routes, the city would starve. It is an undeniable fact.

text.City Parijanah (talking to red bangaa): Begging your pardon, bhadra, but I am off duty, you see. Kah? An organization? His Excellency the Marquis Ondore against the Empire? Many big words, bhadra. Can you say this again, ten times, fast?

text.City Parijanah (leaning against counter): If it is directions which you seek, bhadra, ask another parijanah. I am off duty. Kah? A resistance against the Empire? Please, I am in no mood for such japery today.

text.Timorous Bangaa: Hold it, friend. Hrrm? A "Resistance" ... ? Bah! Nothing of the sort here, traveler. (Why do I always get the odd ones ... )

text.Niray: Good day, bhadra. No ... no, it is not a good day, for my son has run away from home! Should you see him, please, tell him to come back. My son's name is Yrlon, you see. I'm afraid I was too harsh on him for breaking my prized bottle of Bhujerban Madhu ...

text.Kait: I know where my brother has gone, bhadra ... But I cannot tell you. He would be very cross.

text.City Parijanah: Svagatam, traveler. We parijanah are official guides to the city. Outside the aerodrome you will find Travica Way, Bhujerba's main street.

text.Traveler (man in Archadian clothes leani: Contrary to popular belief in these parts, not everyone in Archades has his own airship! No, only the rich and privileged have those.

text.Bhujerban Sainikah: Svagatam, traveler. Welcome to Bhujerba, island of peace in the raging storm that is Ivalice, thanks to his Excellency, the Marquis.

text.Bhujerban (man sitting on rail speaking: From Rabanastre, are you, bhadra? I hear the Imperials are quite bold there. Not so here in Bhujerba, where they know their place.

text.Bhujerban (moogle with yellow pom-pom by: I was shopping and missed my flight for Rabanastre! It's times like these when I think it'd be awfully nifty to be rich and have my own airship, kupo ...

text.Traveler (blonde man in blue): Finally, the skyferry's starting up again ... Of course my airship's still delayed! Tsk. No respect for class, these peasants!

text.Street Kid (sitting on luggage): We go on a family trip to Rabanastre, bhadra! Is it true that, under the Imperial occupation, you cannot buy food or clothing there?

text.Street Kid (near window): When I grow older, bhadra, I will be an airship pilot! A moogle, he is teaching me now, you see. He has just left on the airship for Rabanastre!

text.ACTION: Various lines from Vaan, when "testifying" ...
I'm Captain Basch fon Ronsenburg of Dalmasca!
Don't listen to Ondore's lies!
Basch lives!
I'm THE Basch fon Ronsenburg!
I'm Captain Basch!

Whenever you testify to an ordinary citizen, they will then be labeled as "Informed Citydweller", or "Informed Wayfarer", "Informed Shopkeep", etc. when you talk to them. Various lines from the informed citydwellers, in response ...
(exclusive to moogles) You are being very, very silly, kupo. Captain Ronsenburg died two years ago! Oh, oh, maybe he's been hiding out on a desert isle? Kupo?
(exclusive to moogles) Captain Ronsenburg of Dalmasca, alive, kupo? First I've heard of this ...

text.Informed kid: You are the Captain Ronsenboobi? Oh, what fun! I will play at being captain, too!
Kah? You are Captain Ronsenburg? I had heard that he was quite dead. The Marquis has told us this some time past.
Captain Basch fon Ronsenburg? Haa, the fool who killed the King of Dalmasca and so prolonged that war. How many died because of him?
Basch? You mean the Dalmascan captain? The one executed for slaying his king?
And you are this Captain Ronsenburg? Are you not awfully young for a captain? You would do best to keep quiet, I think.
Haa, I wondered what it was you were shouting. This man you speak of, he is the one who killed the King of Dalmasca ... and was executed, no?
Ah, the one who killed the Dalmascan king, no? If he's alive, that'd cause quite the stir ... 'Course, that's a big "IF"!

text.Informed Shopkeep: The Captain? Alive? Please, keep such pointless rumors out of my establishment, bhadra.
Captain ... Ronsenburg? Haa! I understand! The customer is a mummer, practicing his act! Yes, yes. Very entertaining, if stupid.
Murkha! If you are to lie, bhadra, might I humbly request that you lie better?
A captain of Dalmasca? What of it?
Haa, yes, I remember. The Dalmascan captain, no? His slaying of the king prolonged the war. I had heard he was executed ... was he not?

text.Informed owner of Targe: And you are this Captain Ronsenburg? I had thought him dead ... And now the dead rise to purchase weapons! Frightening!

text.Informed Shopkeep: So you're the Captain, eh? Ah, I see, I see, you want to be a captain when you grow up! Admirable, bhadra! I wish you good luck.
The Dalmascan captain who slew his king? He is long dead, friend. I heard the Marquis's announcement with my own ears.
Ayi? Have you not heard? When Dalmasca fell, the Marquis announced that the Lady Ashe had perished, and the Captain was executed.

text.Informed Moogle: It does not do to lie, kupo. Very bad. Why, Marquis Ondore announced that the captain who killed the king was executed!
But if Captain Ronsenburg were alive ... I wonder what Marquis Ondore would have to say for himself, kupo ...
Then what the Marquis said two years ago, that was a lie, kupo? But why would the Marquis lie to us? It doesn't make any sense at all, kupo.

text.Clio: The Captain, alive, kupo? Oh, I've heard some good ones in my day! That's not one of them, though. If it were true ... kupo ...

text.Informed kid: Captain Ron ... sen ... boobi? Uh ... I've not heard of such a man, but I shall ask Amba. Perhaps she knows.
So, you're Captain Ronsenburg? Well, then I'm the Emperor of Archadia! Ha! Eh? Think I'm crazy? Look who's talking ...
So, you are saying that Marquis Ondore is a liar, bhadra? You are reckless indeed, then. I would not venture out at night, were I you.

text.Informed Shopkeep: Kah? Captain Ronsenburg? Oh, that is choice! Look, I'll believe whatever you like, just buy something, all right?

text.Niray: Ronsen ... burg? Where have I heard this name before? Ah, yes! I remember ... No, no. I do not.
Basch? Who is that? Is he a nobleman? Is he a great man? ... Is he a bad man?

text.Informed Shopkeep: That's ... that Dalmascan captain, no? I had no idea he was so young! How terrible it must be in Dalmasca, that boys must go to war!
Various lines from parijanah, in response ...
Captain Basch fon Ronsenburg? He is gone from this world, surely, bhadra. The Marquis announced it himself!
Kah? The Captain, alive!? Yet he was executed two years past for the slaying of Dalmasca's king! I heard the Marquis's words myself!
Kah!? Captain Ronsenburg, alive? Murkha! Ahem. That is to say, preposterous!
Haa ... And you are this Captain Ronsenburg? Forgive me, bhadra, but you seem a touch young.
Various lines from sainikah, in response ...
Lies, exaggerations, and obfuscations! These are all prohibited in Bhujerba! And slandering His Excellency above all else!
What do you think you are doing, bhadra? Spread any more vicious rumors and I shall have you arrested!
I must ask you to refrain from spreading such lies in public places, bhadra. All here know that Captain Ronsenburg was executed. You would have us doubt the Marquis?
Such talk is not permitted in public places! You will be quiet!

text.ACTION: When the Notoriety meter reaches 100%...
Vaan will be cornered on a backstreet by a few shady characters.

text.Henchman: You. Boy. You will come with us.

text.ACTION: The scene switches to the back of the Cloudborne, where the Timorous Bangaa brings Vaan before n important-looking man sitting at the table.

text.Henchman: This is the one, Havharo. Says he's Captain Basch, he does.

text.Havharo: He would sooner pass for the King.

text.Henchman: I knew he weren't no Captain! That was a mean trick to be playing.

text.Havharo: If at trickery it ended, it would end well enough. But why this boy, and why Captain Ronsenburg? An explanation is due, and I will hear it. The Empire's hounds grow passing bold indeed.

text.ACTION: Balthier and Fran enter.

text.Balthier: A shame if they learnt the Marquis trafficked with the likes of you. Agents masquerading as guides. A hideout at the back of a tavern. Not exactly earning high marks for originality, are we?

text.ACTION: Basch makes his entrance.

text.Havharo: So Basch fon Ronsenburg does yet live.

text.ACTION: The scene fades to black, and fades in again on a different setting.
The Estate of the Marquis Ondore – Drawing Room
Larsa sits at a desk writing, while Penelo sits on a sofa in front of him.

text.Penelo: So Vaan really is all right. I didn't think I'd ever get to see him again.

text.Larsa: You will join him soon. And until then I shall see that you're kept from harm.

text.Penelo: Thank you.

text.ACTION: A pause, then Larsa looks up and sets down his pen.

text.Larsa: I am troubled. The Rabanastre Imperial Guard appear to have overstepped their bounds. I intend to speak on this with the Consul.

text.ACTION: surprised

text.Penelo: What?

text.Larsa: Vayne Solidor, the Consul, is my brother.

text.ACTION: Penelo gasps. Larsa stands and makes his way to the window to look out.

text.Larsa: The first duty of the Consul is to maintain order in Dalmasca. My brother – my brother is not one given to failure. Perhaps things arent going as well as they might be... but give him a little time and he will put things to rights. Be not troubled. My brother is a remarkable man.

text.Penelo: He frightens me.

text.Larsa: Why?

text.Penelo: I'm sorry. He is your brother. It's just -- you don't understand how much we lost to the war. My friends, my parents.

text.Larsa: So, you fear the Empire?

text.ACTION: Penelo nods. He goes to kneel before her.

text.Larsa: Listen to me. The men of my family, we are taught to place the needs of others before our own. I will see that you are kept from harm. It is my duty to House Solidor.

text.Penelo: But how? How can I trust you?

text.Larsa: Because I give you my word. My brother would do no less.

text.ACTION: Fade out, and then back in on the Bhujerban resistance hideout.

text.Havharo: I knew there must be more to it, but to find you at the end of this tale ... Ah, to see the Marquis's face when he learns of it.

text.Basch: I should like nothing more. I would meet him, and see for myself.

text.Ondore's Attendant: There is little to be said. I shall arrange a meeting with the Marquis. We shall expect you at the estate.

text.ACTION: The attendant leaves. The others follow close behind.

text.Ondore's Attendant: His Excellency the Marquis will meet with you shortly, bhadra. Please, make what preparations you must and go to the estate. You will find it at the northern end of Travica Way.

text.Timorous Bangaa: That Havharo ... I don't get 'im. If it's been me, I'd've gutted you and hung you out to dry, not let you out swimmin' all over town. You keep quiet 'bout what you seen in here, friend.

text.City Parijanah (talking to Ondore's atte: If it is directions you seek, bhadra, ask another parijanah. I am off duty. ... Have you met with His Excellency? One can only hope he convinced you of the need for showing restraint on Bhujerba's streets.

text.Melisa: Haa. Hello there, boy. Quite the performance back there. Do not think for a moment that all of us accept you. And watch what you say outside.

text.City Parijanah (with blue jacket): A resistance, bhadra? Ah ha ha! How could such a thing exist in Bhujerba? We have always been neutral with regard to Archadia's wars. If anyone asks you, I should hope you would say the same.

text.City Parijanah (talking to red bangaa): I am sorry, but I am off duty, you see. Hah! I have fooled you, bhadra! No, I am merely pretending to be a drunkard. I wait here to pass messages to those in the organization from other regions, you see.

text.Cloudborne Patron (moogle with yellow po: What's wrong with a moogle wetting his throat, kupo? I may look small, but I'm more grown-up 'n you! I know thots o' lings! Er ... lots o' things!

text.Magu: Harrum? Melisa call for me? Haa ... she didn't? Then don't give me a scare like that. (snort)

text.Cloudborne Patron (man sitting at table: It was hard to relax and enjoy a cup back in Rabanastre with all them Imperials about. Here, I can drink all I like ... to Bhujerba, and freedom!

text.Bhujerban Sainikah (on guard at Marquis': Haa, we've been expecting you. His Excellency the Marquis awaits.
You are ready for your audience, bhadra?

CHOICE.Bhujerban Sainikah (on guard at Marquis': His Excellency the Marquis is otherwise occupied until sunset. Please, I will show you to a place where you may wait in comfort.

text.ACTION: The Marquis's estate, at night. The party meets with him in what seems to be his office or study.

text.Ondore: Sir Basch fon Ronsenburg. It was not so very long ago that I announced you had been executed.

text.Basch: And that is the only reason I draw breath.

text.Ondore: So you are the sword he's strung above my head. Vayne has left not a thing to chance. And?

text.Basch: A leader of the Resistance has fallen into Imperial hands. A woman by the name of Amalia. I would rescue her, but I need your help.

text.Ondore: This resistance leader – this Amalia. She must be very important.

text.ACTION: Basch bows slightly in response.

text.Ondore: You understand I've my position to consider.

text.Vaan: Would you let us see Larsa? He's got my friend with him.

text.Ondore: I'm afraid you're too late. Lord Larsa's cortege has already rejoined the Imperial detachment. I am told they will depart for Rabanastre upon the arrival of the fleet this eventide.

text.ACTION: A very brief cinematic shows the fleet silently hanging over Ondore's estate in the night sky, and a detachment of smaller craft flying out from the flagship toward the estate.
Fade back in on Ondore's office, where Vaan is now being restrained by Balthier and Fran.

text.Vaan: What are we waiting for?

text.Balthier: For you to calm down.

text.Ondore: Captain Ronsenburg. Surely the exigencies of position are not lost on you. Why, indeed, you should find the enemy's chains ... an easy burden to bear.

text.ACTION: A look of shocked comprehension crosses Basch's face. Balthier catches on as well.

text.Balthier: Wait!

text.Basch: Sorry. Can't be helped.

text.ACTION: Basch draws his sword.

text.Ondore: Summon the guard!

text.ACTION: His attendant opens the door to let in a string of sainikah, who proceed to restrain Vaan & co.

text.Ondore: They're to be taken to Judge Ghis.

text.ACTION: The scene fades to black once more, and fades into a different setting.
The Royal Palace of Rabanastre – Consul's Chambers
Vayne looks out the window, while a Judge stands at his desk reporting in -- that same Judge we saw at Nalbina, the one purported to be Basch's twin.

text.Vayne: Those decrepit, basking fools in Archades tie my hands, and look what happens! I tell you, this country's obstinacy knows no bounds.

text.Gabranth: The insurgents in Rabanastre operate alone at present. However, should they garner external support, the situation could worsen. We have found the counter-Imperial elements in Bhujerba to be conspicuously well-funded. No doubt Marquis Ondore is behind this. Ondore must be reined in.

text.Vayne: By that way, the Marquis has written us a letter. He claims that he's recaptured our runaway. He's given him to Ghis.

text.Gabranth: He will die by my hand.

text.Vayne: Your fraternity is moving. Ah, Ghis returns with Larsa. Tomorrow morning they will leave Bhujerba. See him home safely, Gabranth. Now, I'm expecting Doctor Cid. You may leave.

text.ACTION: Gabranth bows, turns his back, and exits the room. As he leaves, he passes by Vayne's next visitor, Doctor Cid, who appears to be enthusiastically talking to himself. He pauses for a moment and looks sidelong at Cid.

text.Cid: We must see the real thing to be sure. Nabudis has taught us much! Yes, it's well hidden. They'll be off chasing after shadows, the fools. Ah, yes. The reins of History, back in the hands of Man.

text.ACTION: turning to Vayne

text.Cid: Hah, Vayne! You seem to be enjoying your job as consul.

text.Vayne: I was kept waiting fully 2 years. What news of Archades? Our honored members of the Senate?

text.Cid: Hard at work as always, trying to find a dagger for your back.

text.Vayne: They are welcome to try.

Go to Clan Primer | Go to Side Quests | Go to Intro & Key

text.ACTION: Another short cinematic shows the fleet in daylight. The party, in chains, is being escorted from one ship to a smaller carrier, and transported to the Leviathan.

text.Imperial: The prisoners, my lord.

text.ACTION: As Vaan and co., still shackled, are escorted to the bridge, we see Amalia is present. Seeing Basch, she scowls and approaches him.

text.Basch: Majesty –

text.ACTION: Upon reaching him, Amalia slaps him squarely across the face.

text.Ashe: After what you've done! How dare you! You're supposed to be dead!

text.Judge Ghis: Come now, come now. Have you forgotten your manners? This is hardly the courtesy due ... the late Princess Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca.

text.Vaan: Princess?

text.Judge Ghis: To be sure, she bears no proof of her former station. No different than any mean member of the insurgence.

text.Ashe: The Resistance.

text.Judge Ghis: The Consul asks the ministry of the disthroned royal family in restoring peace to Dalmasca. Those who foster instability and unrest, who claim royal blood without proof ... they shall meet their fate at the gallows. There are no exceptions.

text.Ashe: I will not play puppet to Vayne.

text.Basch: King Raminas entrusted me with a task. Should the time come, he bade me give you something of great importance. It is your birthright: the Dusk Shard. It will warrant the quality of her blood. Only I know where to find it.

text.Ashe: Wait. You took my father's life! Why spare mine now? You would have me live in shame!

text.Basch: If that is your duty: yes.

text.Vaan: Stop being so stubborn! Keep on like this and you're gonna get us all killed.

text.Ashe: Don't interrupt!

text.ACTION: Suddenly, the stone Vaan stole from the palace treasury begins to glow again.

text.Balthier: Vaan. That stone.

text.Vaan: It was in the palace treasure.

text.Judge Ghis: Well, well. Splendid! You've brought the Stone with you! This spares us a great deal of trouble.

text.Ashe: Don't give it to him!

text.ACTION: Vaan looks at Ashe, then at Balthier, who nods.

text.Vaan: You have to promise: no executions.

text.ACTION: Vaan resignedly hands the stone to Judge Ghis.

text.Judge Ghis: A Judge's duty is to the law. Take them away. Lady Ashe is to be quartered separately.

text.ACTION: The party is escorted off the bridge. Ghis gazes at the stone in his hand.

text.Judge Ghis: Vayne Solidor. What fascination does this hold for you?

text.ACTION: The party is in shackles, being escorted to a small carrier craft.

text.Basch: So you were carrying it all along. The Fates jest.

text.Balthier: Tell these Fates of yours to leave me out.

text.Imperial: Keep quiet!

text.Basch: There was nothing else that I could do. You know that.

text.Balthier: Oh, I understand. Honor, duty, and all that. I still can't believe that was the Princess.

text.Imperial: I said keep quiet!

text.ACTION: The Imperial goes to hit Balthier over the head. Balthier grabs his spear and throws him, taking the weapon in his still shackled hands. After a moment of struggle, two Imperials are down, and the last is taken out by the Judge. The Judge then takes his helmet off – it's Vossler. He begins unlocking the party's shackles, starting with Basch.

text.Basch: The Marquis has been busy.

text.Vossler: Not lightly did I beg his aid. Listen, it has been a full two years. I alone have kept Her Majesty safely hidden. I doubted friend and foe alike. I could trust nobody.

text.Basch: You did your duty. And mine for me.

text.Vossler: I'm getting her out. I need your help.

text.Basch: Of course.

text.ACTION: Vossler joins the party as a guest!
You obtain a map of the Leviathan!
Your location map for this area is complete!

text.Vossler: Wait. A word of caution before we set out. See that red web of light spanning the passageway? It is a mechanism to detect intruders within the ship. Break one of those beams and an alarm will sound, summoning the guard. The alarm should cease after a time, but it's better to avoid drawing unnecessary attention. Come, Her Majesty awaits.

text.ACTION: Security Station: "Insert access key."

text.Vossler: Fear not their numbers! Take down their leaders, and the others will follow!

text.ACTION: After defeating the Imperials ...
You obtain a No. 1 Brig Key!
In cell number C-201 ...
Interact with the Urn ...
You obtain a Systems Access Key!
In cell number C-202 ...
Ashe, sitting alone in the cell, looks up as the others enter, and stands to greet them.

text.Vossler: You are unharmed.

text.Ashe: Vossler! I –

text.ACTION: Ashe stumbles. Vossler goes to catch her.

text.Vossler: Majesty!

text.Ashe: It's nothing. I'll be fine.

text.ACTION: turning to Basch

text.Ashe: You.

text.Vaan: Come on, come on! Let's go! What are you waiting for? Penelo's still out there!

text.Balthier: We should hurry. They won't be long.

text.Vossler: We will talk later.

text.ACTION: Ashe joins the party!
In cell number C-203 ...

text.Lulucce: Kupo! Not a word from you, kupo. I know why you've come! Oh, and thank you for opening the cell door, by the way. Most gracious of you! After this treatment, I think it's safe to say we won't be visiting any more Imperial warships in the near future. The road calls, kupo!

text.Tetran: Kupo? You don't look like any Imperial I've ever seen, kupo. Me, kupo? I am but a humble traveling merchant. As luck would have it, I happen to be traveling here. Would you like to see my wares? I'll warn you, though. I only sell to one kind of customer: the paying kind, kupo!

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.Tetran: Any merchant worth his salt needs but one thing to do business: a customer, kupo!
Interested in making a purchase? Don't worry, I don't even know the meaning of the word extortion, kupo!

text.ACTION: shop menu

text.Tetran: Any merchant worth his salt needs but one thing to do business: a customer, kupo!

text.ACTION: Cell number C-204 is empty.
The alarm suddenly sounds.

text.Basch: Majesty. We will cut you a path.

text.Ashe: I will not place my trust in the sword of a traitor!

text.Vossler: Yet trust his sword we must, traitor or no. I see no other way. We track back, commandeer a ship, and make our escape.

text.ACTION: Ashe says nothing, and starts running.

text.Basch: Her Majesty cannot abide weakness, least of all in herself.

text.Vossler: We must make her confront the reality of our plight.

text.LOCATION: Sub-control Room or Large Freight Stores

text.ACTION: Security Station: "Insert access key."

CHOICE.ACTION: "Systems access key verified. Access granted. Please make your selection."
Anomalous activity detected in Brig No. 1.
Level 3 shipwide alert in in place.
Sub-control Room: Nominal, Station in use"
"Upon resetting, you will have 60 seconds in which to dispose of the source of the anomaly."
"The alarm has been reset. If you do not dispose of the source of the anomaly within 60 seconds, the alarm will sound again."

text.ACTION: Port Section
The party stumbles across none other than Larsa and Penelo in the corridor.

text.Penelo: Vaan!

text.ACTION: She and Vaan embrace each other.

text.Vaan: It's okay. We're okay.

text.Larsa: Ghis knows you've escaped. You must hurry.

text.ACTION: to Vossler

text.Larsa: You are Captain Azelas. You will follow me. We must reach the airships before they do.

text.Vossler: You would let us leave knowing who we are?

text.ACTION: A pause; Larsa turns to Ashe.

text.Larsa: Lady Ashe. By all rights, you ought not even to exist. That you and Captain Ronsenburg were made to appear dead ... is like a hidden thread laid bare. Your actions hereafter will pull at that thread ... and we will see what it unravels. This is our chance. We must see this through, and get to the bottom of it. I believe 'tis for the good of Dalmasca, and the good of the Empire.

text.ACTION: pause

text.Ashe: Very well then.

text.ACTION: smirking

text.Vaan: Thanks, "Lamont."

text.ACTION: to Vaan

text.Larsa: I must apologize.

text.ACTION: to Penelo

text.Larsa: Penelo, for you. May it bring you good fortune.

text.ACTION: Larsa places the nethicite from the mines in Penelo's hands.

text.Penelo: Thanks.

text.ACTION: approaching Vossler

text.Larsa: Let us go.

text.ACTION: Vossler leaves the party.
Penelo joins the party!
You obtain a piece of Manufacted Nethicite!
When the party steps out onto the port launch, Ghis is waiting for them.

text.Judge Ghis: Such a great shame. I must confess: I thought you the one who would help us restore peace to Dalmasca. No matter. We hold the proof of your royal lineage. A maid of passing resemblance will serve our purposes now. As for you, my dear ...

text.ACTION: Ghis summons a great magickal ball of energy which expands and levitates crackling in the air between them.

text.Judge Ghis: The Empire requires you no more.

text.ACTION: Suddenly, the magickal energy is sucked out of the air, as if by a vacuum, and into the glowing magicite in Penelo's hands. The party looks curiously at the stone.

text.Penelo: What was that?

text.Balthier: The nethicite.

text.Judge Ghis: Your Majesty does not disappoint! Ever quick to spurn an honorable surrender, as was your father.

text.ACTION: Ashe, furious, pauses, struggling to find a response.

text.Ashe: You know nothing of my father!

text.ACTION: After defeating Ghis and Imperial soldiers ...
Ghis's helm falls to the ground, and he falls to his knees, his vision hazy. Vossler steps out onto the port launch.

text.Vossler: We've secured an Atomos. Come!

text.ACTION: The party starts forward. Balthier looks dismayed.

text.Balthier: An Atomos? All skiff, no ship. Hardly fitting for a leading man.

text.Vaan: So I can fly it then?

text.Fran: Are you mad?

text.ACTION: They leave quickly.
The scene changes to a cinematic showing the party departing in the Atomos, Fran steering the ship.

text.Penelo: Can't we go faster?

text.Fran: Not yet.

text.ACTION: A couple of small craft pass by within close range. Ashe and Penelo duck beneath the dash and emerge again after they've gone by.

text.Ashe: They passed.

text.Fran: Any faster and they'd have noticed.

text.Penelo: Balthier, your handkerchief. I thought you might want it back.

text.Balthier: I shall wear it close to my heart.

text.ACTION: Focus shifts to the conversation between Ashe, Vossler, and Basch.

text.Ashe: Perhaps you forgot all that Ondore has wrought.

text.Basch: I do not forget, Majesty. It was by his counsel, dangerous though it may have been, that we were able to free you. You must meet with him, Your Highness, and give ear to his words. He may act in league with the Empire, but his heart is not.

text.Vossler: It is as he says. I ought not to have kept Ondore at so great a distance for so long a time. I have played the fool!

text.Ashe: You were only being cautious.

text.Vossler: I would ask you for some time. On our own, we struggle in vain to restore Dalmasca. I must search out some other way. Until I should find it, I would have Basch remain at your side. Doubt him you may, but I measure his loyalty to Dalmasca no less than my own.

text.Ashe: I know you would not speak so lightly. Very well.

text.Vossler: Keep her well. Go to Ondore, and there await my return.

text.ACTION: Vossler departs.
